Sir, two days ago I watched all your videos related to health insurance and, based on that, purchased a Star Health policy through PolicyBazaar.

While buying the insurance, I disclosed all my pre-existing conditions, such as:

Having typhoid fever during childhood (about 13–14 years ago),

Recently having chickenpox (about 2 months ago), and

Currently having gynecomastia on the left side of the chest, which the doctor said is due to hormonal changes.

I provided all this information while applying, but they have now rejected my insurance and are suggesting a different plan.

I want to know — is it true that insurance is denied because of pre-existing diseases? Or is there usually just a waiting period for such conditions?
